13.1 The data sheet of the SN7400 quad 2-input NAND gate of the 기rL
                                                                                        family provides the following:
     Logic-I input voltage requited at both input terminals to ensure a logic-0 level at the output: MIN (minimum) 2 V.
     Logic-0 input voltage required at either input terminal to ensure a 幻gic-i level at the output: MAX (maximum) 0.8
                                                                                                                       V.
     Logic- i output voltage: MIN 2.4 V, TYP (typical) 3.3 V.
     Logic-0 output voltage: TYP 0.22 V, MAX 0.4 V.
     Logic-卜ievel supply current: TYP 12 mA, MAX 22 mA (for the entire package).
     Logic-I-level supply current: TYP 4 mA, MAX 8 mA (for the entire package).
